exposure: grazing supplemented with partial mixed ration (PMR) after calving (T0)
confinement with TMR ad libitum during the first 21 DIM, followed by grazing supplemented with PMR from d 22 onwards until 60 DIM (T21)
cohort: The study included 16 primiparous and 24 multiparous Holstein dairy cows after calving.
finding: Strategic feeding management during the fresh cow period affected metabolic adaptation to lactation, with milk production responses observed only in multiparous cows, and no differences found in the resumption of ovarian cyclicity despite improved endocrine-metabolic profiles in T21.
